categories.main_business_segments: DUAL Co. Ltd operates primarily in the manufacturing of automotive interior materials, including fabrics, seat coverings, and airbag cushions. The company’s business is divided into three main segments: fabric production (woven, knit, tricot), seat coverings (natural leather, synthetic leather, cloth), and airbag cushion supply. It serves automotive seat assembly companies and automobile manufacturers directly.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced textile processing technologies for fabric production, including jacquard and dobby weaving for woven fabrics, and specialized knitting for knit and tricot fabrics. It applies post-processing techniques such as embossing and lamination. For seat coverings, it processes natural and synthetic leathers and cloth materials, focusing on durability, breathability, and aesthetic qualities. Airbag cushions are produced with seam sealing technology to ensure gas retention and safety performance. The company also invests in eco-friendly and functional material development, including bio-based fibers, antimicrobial fabrics, and conductive textile controls.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DUAL’s primary customers are major automobile manufacturers such as Hyundai, Kia, Renault Samsung, and their seat assembly suppliers. The company supplies automotive interior components for various vehicle models across domestic and international markets. Its products are integrated into passenger vehicles, including electric and hybrid models, targeting OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the automotive industry.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales subsidiaries in South Korea, China, Europe (Portugal, Romania, Turkey), and the Americas (Mexico, Brazil, USA). Its sales distribution is approximately 37% domestic (Korea), 43% Europe, 13% China, and 7% Americas. It has established overseas subsidiaries to support local production and sales, including DUAL USA LLC and DUAL BORGSTENA TRIM MEXICO.
categories.supply_chain_position: DUAL operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, manufacturing and supplying interior materials and components to seat assembly companies and automobile manufacturers. It sources raw materials such as yarns, natural and synthetic leathers, and processes them into finished fabrics and seat covers, which are then delivered to Tier 1 suppliers or OEMs for vehicle assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in eco-friendly and high-performance automotive interior materials, including bio-based fibers, recycled yarns, antimicrobial fabrics, and conductive textile technologies for smart interiors. It invests in developing lightweight, breathable, and durable fabrics to meet evolving automotive safety and environmental regulations. Strategic R&D also targets expanding product applications to new vehicle models and markets, with a focus on sustainability and innovation in material science.
categories.revenue_model: DUAL generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured automotive interior products, including fabrics, seat coverings, and airbag cushions. Sales are made directly to automotive OEMs and seat assembly companies, based on contracts and production schedules aligned with vehicle manufacturing timelines. Revenue is recognized from product shipments under negotiated pricing, often influenced by raw material costs, design specifications, and volume forecasts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other automotive interior material suppliers globally, including specialized textile manufacturers and Tier 1 automotive parts suppliers. It holds a competitive position by leveraging advanced textile technologies, diversified product offerings, and global manufacturing footprint. Its key competitive advantages include strong relationships with major Korean automakers and expanding presence in overseas markets, particularly Europe, China, and the Americas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, DUAL reported consolidated revenues of approximately 753 billion KRW, representing a 33% increase year-over-year. Operating profit grew by 231% to 44 billion KRW, and net income increased by 177% to 20.8 billion KRW. The company’s total assets stood at 477 billion KRW with a stable capital structure and improving liquidity ratios. The growth trajectory reflects recovery in the automotive market and increased production of new vehicle models domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DUAL differentiates itself by providing high-quality, technologically advanced automotive interior materials that meet stringent safety, environmental, and aesthetic standards. Its value proposition includes customized fabric designs, eco-friendly and sustainable materials, and integration of functional features such as antimicrobial properties and conductive textiles for smart vehicle interiors. The company’s ability to align closely with OEM development schedules and deliver innovative, durable products supports its competitive edge.
